categories.main_business_segments: AMAX operates primarily in high-performance computing (HPC), artificial intelligence (AI) applications, high-density servers and storage, and liquid cooling integrated cabinets. The company provides comprehensive hardware solutions including AI servers, liquid cooling cabinets, and storage devices, targeting enterprise server hardware solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: AMAX leverages advanced HPC and AI technologies, including the latest GPU architectures (NVIDIA B200, AMD Instinct), distributed AI training architectures, and cutting-edge liquid cooling technologies for energy efficiency. The company emphasizes modular and heterogeneous architecture designs (ARM, FPGA, RISC-V) and integrates software platforms for AI computing optimization and server management. Manufacturing is globally distributed with standardized processes across facilities in the US, Ireland, Taiwan, and China.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include international semiconductor leaders, Silicon Valley startups, cloud service providers, telecom operators, government agencies, research institutions, and enterprises across sectors such as semiconductor manufacturing, AI, information security, and financial services. The company serves markets requiring AI data centers, HPC clusters, and enterprise IT infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: AMAX has a global footprint with manufacturing and sales operations in the United States, Ireland, Taiwan, and China. The company focuses on North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions, with expanding presence in emerging markets like Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and India. The US market remains a core focus due to longstanding operations and customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: AMAX operates primarily in the midstream segment of the server industry supply chain, focusing on system integration, assembly, and customization of servers, storage, and cooling solutions. It sources key components such as CPUs, GPUs, memory, and motherboards from major upstream suppliers and delivers integrated hardware solutions downstream to enterprise and government customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in AI and HPC server technologies, liquid cooling solutions, and edge computing supporting 5G and IoT applications. R&D focuses on enhancing energy efficiency, modular design, and software-hardware integration for AI workload optimization. AMAX also emphasizes ESG initiatives, including green data center technologies and supply chain compliance with environmental and labor standards.
categories.revenue_model: AMAX generates revenue primarily through the sales of hardware products including AI servers, high-density servers, storage solutions, and liquid cooling cabinets. The company also offers turnkey solutions and customized system integration services. Revenue is derived from direct product sales to enterprise customers and strategic OEM/ODM partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AMAX competes with large technology groups and server manufacturers such as Foxconn, Quanta, and Wistron, as well as specialized HPC and AI server providers. Its competitive advantages include long-term presence in the US market, strong customization capabilities, advanced liquid cooling technology, and a diversified global manufacturing footprint. The company positions itself as a leading provider of advanced computing solutions with a focus on energy efficiency and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, AMAX reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$5.49 billion and a net profit of NT$164 million, reflecting resilience amid geopolitical and supply chain challenges. The company has shown steady growth with a global manufacturing base and expanding market reach. R&D investment accounted for about 2.37% of revenue in 2024, supporting ongoing innovation. The company maintains stable earnings per share and dividend policies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AMAX emphasizes delivering total advanced computing solutions with high performance, energy efficiency, and customization tailored to customer needs. Its leadership in liquid cooling technology enables superior thermal management and power savings, aligning with global sustainability trends. The company’s integrated hardware-software platforms and global supply chain flexibility provide customers with reliable, scalable, and cutting-edge AI and HPC infrastructure.
